symptom: ARM NEON zero initialization becomes near-null memory reads (major, 1 instance, crackmes.one 68d40081224c0ec5dcedc2d2 ARM32 ELF trap, _start_main @0x4d4)

witness.before: v2 = *(unsigned int *)(0 + 4); v3 = *(unsigned int *)(0 + 8); v4 = *(unsigned int *)(0 + 0xc); v6 = 0; v1 = 0; v5 = 0;
witness.after: v4 = 0; v1 = 0; v3 = 0; v2 = 0;  (v1/v2 are the two 8-byte halves the vst1 writes)

decisions: The filed hypothesis ('vector-store expansion may treat a constant vector as a source pointer') was overturned by the round-12 refuter and is confirmed wrong here. The vst1 lowering is innocent: ARMneon.sinc:6026 buildVst1DdList is two clean 8-byte stores through mult_addr with no pointer-typed read. The refuter's own diagnosis -- the pointer is born in the vmov's dynamic const-space export -- is confirmed by the raw p-code: `u0x00024200:16 = #0x0:16` then `u0x00024300:16 = *(const,u0x00024200:16)`.

The refuter named RuleLoadVarnode as the wrong-fix trap and that is exactly right, but the reason it cannot fire is one level earlier than 'size 16 is unrepresentable': RuleLoadVarnode is registered in OPPOOL2 (post-blockstructure), not oppool1, so ActionLaneDivide runs first and there is no 16-byte LOAD left by the time RuleLoadVarnode sees the function. What it sees are the four lane LOADs, and it folds only the one at offset 0 -- which is the `v1 = 0` control the refuter identified.

The lane split is the defect, not the missing fold. In the constant space an address IS the value, so `LOAD(const, v+4)` is the constant 4, not the second word of v. Folding the three offset lanes where they stand (the naive fix) would have printed 4, 8 and 0xc and the acceptance probe's stdout_absent clause would have gone green on wrong output.
Shipped as the EQUAL-WIDTH identity only: `out:N = LOAD(const, p:N)` -> `COPY p`, applied in oppool1 so it precedes ActionLaneDivide and each lane is cut from the value.

Regression evidence against wrongness, as the refuter demanded, is measured and not argued: the vendored fixture and the stage test both carry `vmov.i32 q8,#1` beside `vmov.i32 q9,#0`. With the option on the four lanes are 1,1,1,1; with it off they are the `v1._0_16_` pointer arithmetic. The witness binary cannot detect a truncating fix because its immediate is zero.

A constant pointer is deliberately left to RuleLoadVarnode rather than handled here: its apply_op also clears the spacebase-placeholder trigger a call sets up and calls resolve_spacebase_relative, which a bare COPY would drop. A LOAD whose output is that placeholder is declined for the same reason.

No new Action: this is a Rule in the existing oppool1, so the universal schedule's pass adjacencies (verify_w8x_allowlist) are untouched. It does move the byte-exact list_action_decompile_oracle fixture by one line (the rule renders as a leaf), and the w8 leaf count 279 -> 280.

The first cut of this rule also resized: SUBPIECE(p,0) when N < S and INT_ZEXT p when N > S. The corpus sweep caught it. Those arms changed 5 further binaries, all statically linked AVX-512 glibc, by re-rendering `k` mask registers at their true width (`& 0xff` for the 8-lane vpcmpd, `& 0xffff`/`& 0xffffffff` for vpcmpub/vptestmb). Most of that was a faithful rendering improvement and deleted no statement -- but in the __strlen_evex-shaped `sub_476bc0` of two of them it was WRONG: at `label_476da0`, reached both by fall-through and by a goto, the live mask ended up in `v1`/`v4` on one path and `v9` on the other while the scan loop read `v3`, a stale mask from the previous compare. The option-off arm used one variable `v2` on all three paths and was correct. Withdrawing the resize arms removed all 5 diffs -- re-measured, the shipped rule changes exactly 1 of 122 compared binaries, the witness. The refuter predicted the shape of this trap (it warned the acceptance probe would go green on a wrong fix); the trap was one level over from where it pointed -- not a truncated constant, but a lost reaching definition.

promoted_probe.why: the need's target is binary_source dataset and CI has no dataset; the need record keeps the dataset acceptance so every later B_VERIFY still runs the real witness
